name: Nex
long_description: Nex turns your GTM goals into complex GTM agents only the world's best GTM engineers know to build, across 1000+ integrations. Instead of just chatting, the agent writes code as it works to make workflows deterministic, fast, and cheap to re-run, and delivers real output: a lead list, a Slack message, or a live structured data table. Built for teams.
one_liner: Claude Cowork using any AI model, starting with GTM agents
